stage_or_date: Bankruptcy decreed 5 Dec 2025; converted to concurso preventivo May 2026 (reported 2026-05-14)
the_problem: Saladillo-based ultralight helicopter maker Cicaré fell into payment default: its Banco Credicoop debt grew from $9 million (Aug 2023) to $293 million (Jan 2026) out of more than $758 million in total loans, and Credicoop's bankruptcy petition led to a bankruptcy decree on 5 Dec 2025.
the_decision: Company president Juan Manuel Cicaré filed to convert the bankruptcy into a concurso preventivo to renegotiate its debt instead of closing. His stated reason in the court filing: a 'desequilibrio financiero' caused by Covid-19 freezing its foreign expansion planned from late 2019, recession and high inflation, and 'el alto costo del dinero... Las tasas de interés son altamente positivas y desproporcionadas', plus pressure from lenders; he argued the international civil aviation market was reactivating and would let it find 'un nuevo punto de equilibrio'.
the_outcome: Court (Juzgado Comercial N° 29) converted the bankruptcy to a concurso preventivo; declared liabilities $1,050 million vs assets $1,036 million, 16 employees, labor debt $25 million and social-charge debts totalling $241 million; creditor claims due 12 June 2026 and informative hearing set for 9 April 2027. Outcome of the restructuring is still open.
